what: Hero collage slide: when advancing, all pieces of the current slide (photos · speech bubbles · vertical text) get sucked into the center of the panel, shrinking to .5x and vanishing (.4s power2.in). The disc color behind changes to the next slide’s color over .45s, and the next slide’s pieces burst out from the center at .5x and settle in place (1.5s power4.out, each piece delayed .2~.65s). It advances itself every 5 seconds and the time left in the current dot fills as a bar. On first load the first slide’s pieces spread out from the center from 0x and the button group grows while rotating from −20°

options.in: Burst-out duration (sec), default 1.5 — set per piece with data-dur
options.shrink: Scale when sucked in and bursting out, default .5
options.tint: Duration of the disc color change (s), default .45
options.start: If ”event”, the first entrance (after the loader) happens when the fx:play event is received — if the event’s detail.quick is set, pieces start .4s earlier and the disc grows from .8x
options.grow: Scale at which the disc starts growing when opened without a loader, default .8
options.reveal: Time in seconds when fx:reveal is sent, default 1.2 (.65 if quick) — the header and News rows drop in here
options.[data-fx-part=viewport]·[data-fx-part=tr: embla root, track, slides — slides are stacked on top of each other
options.[data-fx-part=piece]: Pieces inside a section — data-delay (delay when advancing) · data-dur · data-in (delay of first appearance)
options.[data-fx-part=disc]: Back plate that changes color — per section, using the --fx-disc color in style
options.[data-fx-part=prev]·[data-fx-part=next]·: Button · dot slot (the part creates the dot) · button group (first entrance rotation)
